vram.title: Mega Drive VRAM estimate
vram.ok: Estimated usage is within the safe range for map assets.
vram.warning: High usage: review tilesets and background images before building.
vram.critical: Near the limit: sprites and engine assets may push the game over VRAM.

hardwareReport.title: Hardware budget
hardwareReport.unavailable: The report is unavailable for this workspace.
hardwareReport.freshness: This report reads available build files. ELF/ROM correspondence with current sources has not been verified.
hardwareReport.notBuilt: No ELF found. Build the project to get linker information.
hardwareReport.abiAssumption: The SGDK 1.81 reader was explicitly selected. It does not automatically identify the version used for this build.
hardwareReport.chooseReader: Select SGDK 1.81 only if that version was used to build. Without a reader, resource structures remain unknown.
hardwareReport.ramUnknown: Static RAM excludes peak heap usage, the stack and buffers created during execution.
hardwareReport.planHelp: Reservations and consumers are declared in hardwareBudget in retro-studio.json. They form a plan, not a runtime measurement.
hardwareReport.limits: 64 KiB VRAM · 4 palettes of 16 entries · {sprites} sprites · {line} sprites per line
hardwareReport.unknowns: Per-frame DMA, scanline load, palette assignments and actual VRAM occupancy remain unknown. Animation frames reuse the per-instance reservation.

status.unsupported-resource: No reader for this type yet

warning.overlapping-reservations: VRAM reservations overlap. Correct their addresses.
warning.sprite-table-limit: Instances exceed the sprite table. Reduce simultaneous instances or pieces per frame.
warning.vram-capacity-limit: Tiles and reservations exceed 64 KiB. Reduce unique tiles, instances or reservations.
warning.tile-arena-capacity: Tiles exceed the planned arena. Reduce tiles/instances or revise the VRAM layout.
warning.tile-arena-overlap: The tile arena overlaps reservations. Correct the addresses before using this plan.

hardwareReport.addressMap: Planned reservations in 64 KiB VRAM. Empty areas do not indicate free runtime memory.

suggestion.uncompressed-tiles: {tiles} uncompressed tiles take {bytes} bytes of ROM. If loading time allows, declare compression (FAST or BEST) on the resource line.
suggestion.many-unique-tiles: the image has {tiles} unique tiles. Reduce variation and dithering, or split the image, so it fits in VRAM with the other consumers.
suggestion.sprite-hardware-pieces: the largest frame uses {sprites} hardware sprites (the console draws 20 per line). Adjust the crops or rescomp optimization to use fewer pieces.
suggestion.sprite-frame-tiles: the largest frame uses {tiles} VRAM tiles per instance. Reduce the crop or move the large animation to another resource.
suggestion.static-ram-high: static RAM is {bytes} bytes of the console's 65536. Reduce global tables and buffers to leave room for the stack and SGDK.
suggestion.rom-large: the ROM is {bytes} bytes, above 4 MiB: a bank mapper is required, or reduce audio and images.
suggestion.sound-rom: takes up to {bytes} bytes of ROM. Shorten the sound, lower the source sample rate or reuse a similar effect.

hardwareReport.romBytesUpTo: up to {bytes} bytes of ROM (distance to the next symbol)

romDebug.unproven: There is no IDE build record linking this ROM to these symbols. Function names may not match; build from the IDE to be sure.

romDebug.vdpHelp: Read from the emulated chip at this instant. Descriptions come from the emulator, in English.

romDebug.confirmRun: Without breakpoints the game will run until debugging is ended: this emulator cannot pause. Press Continue again to confirm, or add a breakpoint first.
romDebug.buildCancelled: Debug build cancelled. The next build cleans and rebuilds everything.
